sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 1000. Success value 100. 5x physical damage that pierces through damage reduction/reflection effects (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Applies Field Obstacle to the enemy Field.
-Target: all enemies. Amplifies Unison Gauge reducing effects by 50% for 40 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 50.
-Target: all enemies. Changes Cost held to 30. [Demerit]
-Applies Field Protect to the allied Field.
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 90 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Applies Dawn for 150 seconds (increases max HP and all stats by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; recovers 10 Cost when using an Ability. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; applies Dual Attack; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: yourself. Applies Ambush for 150 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; reduces the cooldown time of Abilities to 0 (except for certain Abilities); nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Resolute Element (increases all stats by 120%, increases max HP by 120%, and increases status ailment resistance by 30) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Increases max Unison gauge capacity by 30 when equipped in the main slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 40000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 150 seconds.
Time and Star Defense from Unison Damage +700
